theorems.name: Submission.dtc_imrep_of_null_off_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep V n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → ∃ R' : IMRep U n, R'.carrier ⊆ K ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R'.action ω = R.action ω
